identityRule: questionId is immutable; fieldId is mutable metadata.

<questionId>.note: seen is derived as attemptCount > 0; do not persist a separate seen flag.

rules.qualifyingCorrect: first submission AND correct AND no hint AND no explanation AND answer not revealed
rules.nonQualifyingPresentation: wrong, hint-used, explanation-used, or answer-revealed => currentStreak becomes 0
rules.historyRetention: attempts and questionStats are never deleted by wrong answers or recategorization
rules.recategorization: change only field assignment metadata; attempts remain keyed by questionId
rules.seenAfterRecategorization: seen = attemptCount > 0, so a solved item never becomes unseen merely because it moved fields
rules.activeSessionDuringRecategorization: active session keeps its field/revision snapshot; future sessions use the latest assignment
rules.masteryAfterRecategorization: old masteryEvent remains historical, but if its assignment revision is older than current it is shown as 要再確認 rather than current mastery
rules.contentClarification: wording/figure/explanation-only change keeps questionId and increments contentRevision
rules.mathematicalTaskChange: changed givens/target/correct answer => new questionId; old item becomes deprecated but history stays
rules.gradingChange: answer-acceptance-only change keeps questionId and increments gradingRevision
rules.shortageField: Keep all attempts and allow practice, but do not create a masteryEvent while fewer than 4 eligible distinct questions exist in the current field.
rules.secondaryPracticeHistory: An attempt from a secondary practice pool is stored under the same immutable questionId. It is not duplicated under the field. practiceFieldIdAtAttempt is only an analytics snapshot.
rules.practiceTagChange: Adding/removing a practiceFieldId never deletes or rewrites attempts. Past attempts remain visible because questionId is unchanged.
rules.supportQuestionHistory: Support items use immutable SUP-* questionIds and the same attempt schema. Adding/removing a support item from a field never deletes its past history.
rules.sourceDirectMapping: Only core160 questions participate in sourceQuestionId -> direct Level2 mapping. Field-support questions have no sourceQuestionId.
